fields.label: ಓದುವಿಕೆ
fields.value: I Came Upon a Lighthouse — partially read

lead:
This page documents ನನ್ನ planned learning — certifications I haven't yet obtained, tools I haven't yet mastered, ಮತ್ತು courses I'm currently in progress on. **Nothing here is a current skill or finished item.** This is ನನ್ನ honest future agenda.

ನನ್ನ overarching career direction is **Computer Networking, Cloud Computing, ಮತ್ತು Cyberಭದ್ರತೆ**, ಮತ್ತು ನನ್ನ certification plan reflects this directly. I've sequenced it: ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ing fundamentals first (CompTIA Network+, CCNA), then ಭದ್ರತೆ (Security+, CEH), then cloud (AWS, OCI, Azure).

content.content:
**CS50 Introduction to Cyberಭದ್ರತೆ (Harvard)** — I started this on edX / cs50.harvard.edu. It covers cyberಭದ್ರತೆ fundamentals: threats, vulnerabilities, defensive techniques, cryptography basics, web ಭದ್ರತೆ. ಸ್ಥಿತಿ: started, not yet completed. I still have remaining modules ಮತ್ತು the final ಯೋಜನೆ to do.

**Vim / Neovim** — Not fully started yet. Learning through vimtutor (built into Vim). Neovim ಜೊತೆ LazyVim config is already ನನ್ನ editor in the [[linux-setup|Omarchy ಸೆಟಪ್]], but deeper proficiency at the keybinding level is still being developed.

content.title: ಪ್ರಸ್ತುತ ಓದುತ್ತಿರುವುದು
content.content: Partially reading 'I Came Upon a Lighthouse' by Shantanu Naidu — a personal memoir about an intergenerational friendship ಮತ್ತು mentorship. Not a business book. About human connection ಮತ್ತು life lessons. I need to finish the remaining chapters.

content.title: ಇನ್ನೂ ಯಾವುದೇ ಉದ್ಯಮ ಪ್ರಮಾಣೀಕರಣ ಪಡೆದಿಲ್ಲ
content.content: As of June 2026, I have no formal industry certifications. The Linux Fundamentals course certificate is a basic course cert. CS50 Cyberಭದ್ರತೆ is started but not completed. Everything below is planned ಜೊತೆ no set timeline.

rows.ನನಗೆ ಇದು ಏಕೆ ಬೇಕು: Good foundation before Security+. Networking fundamentals.
Gold standard ಗಾಗಿ ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ing roles in India. High priority ಗಾಗಿ me.
Most recognised first cert in cyberಭದ್ರತೆ. I'll do this after Network+.
EC-Council — offensive ಭದ್ರತೆ focus. After Security+.
Easiest entry into cloud certs — validates cloud fundamentals.
Oracle Cloud — directly relevant given ನನ್ನ existing [[homelab|OCI homelab]] ಸೆಟಪ್.
Microsoft Azure entry cert — rounds out multi-cloud exposure.

content.content:
**Obsidian (advanced features)** — I currently use Obsidian as a personal wiki host but only scratch the surface. ವೈಶಿಷ್ಟ್ಯs I want to actually learn: Dataview plugin (query notes like a database), Canvas (visual mind maps), graph filters, templates, tag hierarchies, backlink navigation, ಮತ್ತು core plugin configuration.

**Hermes Agent (Nous Research)** — A self-improving autonomous AI agent (Feb 2026, 123,000+ ಗಿಟ್‌ಹಬ್ stars, MIT license). Runs across 15+ platforms from a single install. Natural language cron jobs, model-agnostic, closed learning loop, GEPA self-improvement. ಸ್ಥಿತಿ: on hold indefinitely. ನನ್ನ current [[homelab|Oracle Cloud VM]] (1 OCPU, 1 GB RAM) is too limited — Hermes needs 24 GB+ RAM. Blocked until the ARM Ampere situation resolves.

I prioritise **CCNA ಮತ್ತು Security+** as the two highest-value items ಗಾಗಿ ನನ್ನ target career in ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ing ಮತ್ತು cloud. Both are recognised hiring signals in India — CCNA ಗಾಗಿ ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ engineering roles ಮತ್ತು Security+ ಗಾಗಿ ಭದ್ರತೆ-adjacent roles.

ನನ್ನ approach throughout is to build real things alongside studying theory. Each certification target connects to something I've already built: ನನ್ನ [[privacy-stack|ಗೌಪ್ಯತಾ ಸ್ಟಾಕ್]] demonstrates the practical ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ing knowledge that Network+ covers in theory; ನನ್ನ [[homelab|homelab architecture]] demonstrates the cloud concepts that AWS/OCI certs formalise.

No timeline is set ಗಾಗಿ any certification. The honest status is: none started, all planned.
None of these are current skills or finished. These are honest future agenda items.
content.author: Learning Plans document, April 2026
